note:
Trial 249 ended in death. The screen reads "TRIAL END: DEATH" with the message that the player was slain by a Spider.

What happened visually:
- The countdown screenshots showed a spider on the ridge ahead. Once combat began, my view had shifted to face a dirt hillside and the spider was no longer visible.
- Health dropped steadily across every subsequent frame while I turned right, turned around, looked down with the shield raised, and backed up. The spider never appeared on screen in any of those frames.
- The final sprint forward ended with the death screen, confirming the spider was the attacker.

Input problem: no command errors, but the attacker stayed off-screen the entire fight. The spider likely was directly beneath or at the camera's edge, where my turn increments of roughly 90 to 180 degrees kept missing it. A faster, smaller sweep with the camera pitched down would have been the better search pattern.
